specification_compliance: The diff touches five paths: docs/specs/INDEX.md and docs/specs/excel-actual-size.md, which are implicit touch points; frontend/src/components/office/excelAdapter.ts, which is listed; frontend/src/components/__tests__/FilePreview.excelActualSize.test.tsx, which is listed as added; and frontend/src/components/__tests__/FilePreview.excelFontSize.test.tsx, which is listed as replaced and is deleted. No path falls outside the touch-point list.

Inside excelAdapter.ts, the change is limited to the SpreadsheetOptions type (beforeTransformData added), the new helpers and createSheetSizing (lines 20-264), which replace correctFontSizes, and the wiring in drawExcel (lines 273-278). The rest of drawExcel (focus release, input lock, ResizeObserver, dispose, preview and reload, lines 280-367) is unchanged. The touch point names exactly this: 'the two options and their functions, replacing SPEC-CORE-167's transformData function'.

The workbook and sheets are changed only in the library's in-memory objects of the current drawing: row and column objects, font objects, picture ranges, worksheet._columns, and grid cols entries. This matches §4. Nothing is written to a file or sent over the network.
INDEX.md changes the SPEC-CORE-167 row to superseded and adds the SPEC-CORE-168 row, which matches the INDEX touch point.
potential_unspecified_behavior: beforeTransformData creates rows 1 to 100 through worksheet.getRow. The spec covers this (§1.2, I1), but it is a structural change to the in-memory workbook that the library reads, and it reaches beyond sizes. It is within the declared touch point and invariants, so it is not reported.
regression_risks: The library's undocumented options beforeTransformData and transformData depend on the exact version pin of @js-preview/excel. An upgrade that changes their call order, or the one-sheet-per-worksheet mapping, would misalign records[i] with sheets[i]. The spec declares this risk, and it is outside this question.
test_coverage: FilePreview.excelActualSize.test.tsx replaces the deleted SPEC-CORE-167 test file and has one or more describe blocks per invariant I1 to I8. No test outside the touch-point list was edited.
